issues.display_title: Issue #4049: Implement Ocean Coordinate Warning & Disable Publish Action
issues.main_description_html:
Task Description

  • Pre-check (Client-side): Check the panorama's lat/lng data when loading publish. If the average coordinates are at 0,0, immediately show danger toast the “Publish to Google” button clicked.
  • Error Handling (Server-side response): Catch the error response from the backend if the user attempts to force a publish, and display a warning.
  • Display a red warning element with the following text: “The image is in the ocean and Google does not accept images there.”

issues.display_title: Issue #4051: Integrate Review Button at Support Page
issues.main_description_html:
Task Description

Overview

Integrate the Review button on the Support Photographer page (Featured Photographers) so that clicking it opens a modal dialog for reviewing a photographer's request.

Context

This task follows the layout update in #4050 (Slicing Update Layout Support Photographer). The table on the Featured Photographers page has a Review button in the Action column for each photographer entry. Currently the button is not wired to any action.

Tasks

  • Show modal review photographer when Review button is clicked
  • Display photographer details inside the modal (name, subscription, userID, request date, current status)
  • Provide Approve and Deny action buttons inside the modal
  • On Approve -> update status to Approved and close modal
  • On Deny -> update status to Denied and close modal
  • Show loading state while the action is being processed
  • Show success/error feedback after action is completed
  • Close modal on backdrop click or close button

Expected Behavior

  1. User clicks Review button on a photographer row in the Featured Photographers table
  2. A modal appears with the photographer's detail information
  3. User can choose to Approve or Deny the request
  4. The status in the table updates accordingly after confirmation
  5. Modal closes after action is taken

Design Reference

Refer to the Featured Photographers design in Figma for layout and styling:
https://www.figma.com/design/jDH5icFzVdkfYrA2VfQoPe/FInal-GoThru--Dashboard?node-id=5924-95786

issues.display_title: Issue #4063: Implement Notify Support Button and Update Photographer Status Layout
issues.main_description_html:
Task Description

Brainstorming File:
2026-06-02-notify-support-button-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

AC-1: Description text

  • The description paragraph on the page reads exactly: "Thank you for applying to become a photographer. Your submission has been securely saved and is currently under review by our team. We will notify you of any status updates directly via email. If you make any changes to your application, please click the 'Notify Support' button so we can review your latest updates."
  • The old description ("If you have any questions or need to confirm your application details, please feel free to reach out to us.") no longer appears

AC-2: Button label

  • The primary button label reads "Notify Support"
  • The "Contact Support" label no longer appears on this page
  • The "Edit Submission" secondary button is unaffected

AC-3: API call

  • Pressing "Notify Support" sends POST /photographers/{gothruUserId}/notify-update where {gothruUserId} is the authenticated user's photographer ID
  • No request body is required
  • The request uses the same base URL as all other API hooks in the project

AC-4: Loading state

  • While the request is in-flight, the "Notify Support" button shows a spinner (NextUI isLoading prop)
  • While the request is in-flight, the button is disabled and cannot be pressed again (NextUI isDisabled prop)
  • The "Edit Submission" button is not affected by the loading state

AC-5: Toast on completion

  • On a successful API response, a toast notification is displayed using the project's useToast hook with toast({ data: res })
  • On an API error, a toast notification is displayed using toast({ data: err })
  • After either outcome the button returns to idle (enabled, no spinner)

AC-6: Locale — English

  • t_photographer.t_submission.t_thank_you in en.json contains the new description text
  • t_photographer.t_submission.t_notify_support exists with value "Notify Support"
  • t_photographer.t_submission.t_contact_support no longer exists in en.json

AC-7: Locale — other languages

  • All non-English locale files contain t_photographer.t_submission.t_thank_you with the updated English text as a placeholder
  • All non-English locale files contain t_photographer.t_submission.t_notify_support with value "Notify Support" as a placeholder
  • t_photographer.t_submission.t_contact_support is removed from all locale files
  • t_payment_status.t_contact_support in every locale file is untouched

issues.display_title: Issue #4064: Bug Fix Missing View Virtual Tour and View Google View Virtual Tour in Virtual Tour Menu at My Tour
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File:
2026-06-03-virtual-tour-dropdown-fix-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

  • A tour with overlay_active: true (and no has_main_overlay) shows the dropdown button with only "View Virtual Tour"
  • A tour with goverlay_active: true (and no has_main_overlay) shows the dropdown button with only "View Google Virtual Tour"
  • A tour with has_main_overlay: true (and no active overlays) shows the dropdown button with "Edit Virtual Tour" and "Virtual Tour Manager" — no view items
  • A tour with all three flags true shows all 4 items
  • A tour with all three flags false shows no dropdown button
  • "View Virtual Tour" navigates to the gothru hosted overlay URL (getTourLink(item, 'F1')) in a new tab
  • "View Google Virtual Tour" navigates to the Google overlay URL (getTourLink(item, 'G1')) in a new tab
  • "Edit Virtual Tour" opens the overlay editor via openOverlayEditor(item.tour_key)
  • "Virtual Tour Manager" navigates to /my-tours/${item.moderation_id}/hosted
  • Menu items always render in order: View Virtual Tour → View Google Virtual Tour → Edit Virtual Tour → Virtual Tour Manager (items that don't meet their condition are simply absent, not reordered)
  • Both grid view (TourCard) and list view (ToursTable) reflect the corrected button visibility

Note from Developer

The “View Google Virtual Tour” and “View Virtual Tour” menus have been running like this since the beginning.. To display them, you must first activate the main virtual tour. Here's how to display them:

Screencast.From.2026-06-03.10-37-56.mp4

I checked the reported tour, and it's likely that the main tour hasn't been activated yet. I even checked and the tour (overlay.json) doesn't even exist yet.
